description: Returns single-property CMBS loans as operating comparables: revenue, operating expenses, NOI (each per square foot), expense ratio, occupancy, DSCR and valuations, filtered by property type, metro, state, size and year built, with medians over every match. Use it for market operating benchmarks; use search_loans for loan status and terms.

limit.description: Up to 25 without a key, 400 with one; the medians always cover every match

name: comps

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation comps). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

asOf.description: End date of the latest reporting period in the filings behind this build, YYYY-MM-DD.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

capped.description: Free plan only: true when the list stopped at the plan's 25 rows.

csvCap.description: Pro only, present only when total is above it: the most rows a CSV holds on this plan (5,000).

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

medians.description: Medians over every match, not just the rows returned.

dscr.description: Median filed debt service coverage ratio.

expenseRatio.description: Median of operating expenses divided by revenue, a fraction of 1.

noiPerSqft.description: Median of NOI divided by square feet, dollars per square foot per year (not rounded).

opexPerSqft.description: Median of operating expenses divided by square feet, dollars per square foot per year.

valuePerSqft.description: Median of the latest valuation (appraisal) divided by square feet, dollars per square foot.

note.description: Free plan only, with capped: text saying how many matches were shown.

results.description: The matches, largest loan balance first (25 on the free plan, up to 400 with a key).

appraisal.description: Most recent valuation amount as filed, in dollars; null when not filed.

appraisalDate.description: Date of the most recent valuation, YYYY-MM-DD; null when not filed.

cbsa.description: Census CBSA (metro area) code as a string; null when the property is not in a metro area.

dscr.description: Latest debt service coverage ratio on NOI as filed (a ratio); null when not filed.

expenseRatio.description: opex divided by revenue, a fraction of 1 rounded to 3 places; null when either is missing.

finEnd.description: End date of the most recent financial statement the figures come from, YYYY-MM-DD; null when not filed.

noi.description: Latest net operating income on a yearly basis, whole dollars; null when no usable yearly figure.

noiPerSqft.description: noi divided by sqft, dollars per square foot per year, rounded to cents; null when either is missing.

occ.description: Latest physical occupancy as filed, a fraction of 1 (0.7603 is 76.03%); null when not filed.

opex.description: Latest yearly operating expenses from the servicer's statement, in dollars; null when not filed or when the statement cannot be read as a year's.

opexPerSqft.description: opex divided by sqft, dollars per square foot per year, rounded to cents; null when either is missing.

revenue.description: Latest yearly revenue from the servicer's statement, in dollars; null when not filed or when the statement cannot be read as a year's.

revenuePerSqft.description: revenue divided by sqft, dollars per square foot per year, rounded to cents; null when either is missing.

sqft.description: Net rentable square feet as filed; null when not filed.

title.description: Property name as shown on its page.

type.description: Property type group. Values: office = Office; retail = Retail; multifamily = Multifamily; lodging = Hotel; industrial = Industrial (includes warehouse); mixed-use = Mixed use; self-storage = Self storage; manufactured-housing = Manufactured housing; healthcare = Healthcare; other = Any other Schedule AL property type.

units.description: Units, beds or rooms as filed (Schedule AL unitsBedsRoomsNumber): apartments, hotel rooms, beds; null when not filed.

valueUW.description: Property value at securitization, in dollars; null when not filed.

valueUWDate.description: Date of that securitization valuation, YYYY-MM-DD; null when not filed.

yearBuilt.description: Year built as filed; null when not filed.

total.description: Count of properties matching the filters (single-property, not defeased loans only).

title: Property comps
